Answer: A
Reason: The chest X-ray demonstrates significant widening of the mediastinum, particularly on the right side, accompanied by a large right-sided pleural effusion (indicated by the dense opacity and meniscus sign). This combination is highly suggestive of fibrosing mediastinitis, a condition that can encase and compress mediastinal structures like the superior vena cava, leading to SVC syndrome.
